preReview.title: Portland 'have the talent' to improve, says Cifuentes
preReview.description: Marti Cifuentes claimed his first MLS win as Portland Timbers coach last time out, as his new team beat San Diego FC 3-1.

preReview.title: Cifuentes: «Portland tiene el talento necesario para mejorar»
